newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Metro, Ore.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Metro, Ore.

text.p: (Metro Washington Park Zoo Oregon Project), 1996 Series A NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed or telecopied bids will be received on behalf of Metro, an elected regional
government located in the urban portions of Multnomah, Clackamas and Washington Counties, Oregon (Metro''), for the purchase of its General Obligation Bonds (Metro
Washington Park Zoo Oregon Project), 1996 Series A (the Bonds''), until 10:00 o'clock a.m. (Pacific Time) on
at the offices of Metro in Portland, Oregon, at which time the bids will be publicly opened and announced. Metro will act on the bids within four hours.

The Bonds will be dated November 1, 1996, will be in book- entry form in denominations of $5,000 each or integral multiples, and will mature in varying amounts from January 15, 1998 to January 15, 2017. The Bonds are callable beginning on January 15, 2007 at par.

In the opinion of Preston Gates & Ellis, Bond Counsel, assuming compliance by Metro with its covenants relating to the tax-exempt status of the Bonds, interest on the Bonds is excluded from gross income for purposes of federal income taxation under Section 103(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the Code''). The Bonds are not private activity bonds'' under Section 141 of the Code.

Complete copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale will be published in the Preliminary Official Statement for the Bonds, which is available from Metro's financial advisor: Gardiner & Clancy, LLC, 115 NW First Avenue, Suite 401, Portland, Oregon 97209, telephone (503) 221-1126; Attention Janet Gallagher.
By Order of The Metro Council
